name: Ocean Blue 6 / 302
headline: The 2BDR Compelling Condo | 5 min to CAI Airport.
summary: This exclusive 2 bedroom designer apartment is located inside a very unique gated complex, 5 minutes to Cairo International Airport

description.Space:
very fast fiber optic WiFi and 24 hour security surveillance.
This apartment is perfect for families and business travelers. The apartment includes a spacious reception area with a combined living and dining room along with a fully equipped modern kitchen, cooking utensils and a coffee machine. The living room is furnished with a sofa set along with a 55 inch smart TV with Chromecast and AirPlay built-in for further personal entertainment. 
There are two bedrooms (one with a queen bed and the other with two single beds) and two bathrooms (one full bathroom with a bath tub shower and a guest bathroom)
Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 
- Free of charge street parking is available.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction: Guests can text and call anytime they need help and i can be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.
description.Neighborhood:
-Cafés and restaurants are along Ankara street which is about a 10 minute walk from the complex.
- Banks and other services are also within walking distance (inside Sun City Mall)
- Sun City Mall (banks and shopping) and Cairo Complex (for dining options) are within a 5 minute walking distance. 
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 5 min drive.
description.Transit:
We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours. 
All places are reachable by car, Uber app and Careem app but if you wish to take a walk it's takes no more than 5 minutes to reach any of the services around.
description.Notes:
Please note the following: 
-PLEASE NOTE: Check-in time is at 3:00 PM, and our team is unavailable between 1:00 AM and 10:00 AM.
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 
- Free of charge street parking is available.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from the community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 
* To use the pool in the compound you have to pay extra fees to use this privilege.

Thank you for choosing our home for your holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays
